scripts.voice: .venv-kokoro/bin/python scripts/make-voice.py --model kokoro/kokoro.onnx --voices kokoro/voices.bin --voice am_michael --speed 0.95 --plan plan.json --out public/content/ai-os/audio
scripts.voice:16k: for f in public/content/ai-os/audio/vo-*.wav; do case "$f" in *-16k.wav) continue;; esac; ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i "$f" -af apad=pad_dur=0.5 -ar 16000 -ac 1 -c:a pcm_s16le "${f%.wav}-16k.wav"; done
